thread:
Maria: heads up — PR #4823 failing premerge SAST on staging, looks like KMS decrypt denied. cc @Ajay

Ajay: on it. which service account?

Maria: sast-scanner@infra. Error snippet:
```
ERROR: Decrypt failed: PermissionDenied: projects/.../cryptoKeys/...: Permission 'cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt' denied to serviceAccount:sast-scanner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

Ajay: thx. that SA was recently moved from 'keystore-reader' to 'keystore-limited' in last week's RBAC change. I'm rolling back to test.

Lucy: FYI this blocks release if premerge can't run. Any quick workaround?

Ajay: We can grant an ephemeral grant via IAM for the scanner or add the decrypt role to the scanner SA temporarily. I'll request an ephemeral grant now. /cc @security-oncall

security-oncall: Proposal: for scan runners we should prefer short-lived creds/workload identity with limited KMS:decrypt, not broad long-lived roles. Filed SDLC-345 to track long-term fix.

Maria: Can we patch CI to fallback to cached SAST bundles to unblock the PR? We have a cache for scanner artifacts.

Ajay: Yes — adding a GH Actions fallback step. Pushing branch `ci/sast-fallback` now.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: GH action run triggered: actions/ci/sast#123 (running with fallback path)

Maria: :thumbsup: keep me posted.

Lucy: Also we need to correlate KMS audit logs to the PR and commit — who flipped the role and when. We should include commit SHA in the audit query.

Ajay: Good call. Example gcloud to search KMS decrypt events for the scanner SA:
```
gcloud logging read "resource.type=cloud_kms_keyring AND protoPayload.methodName=\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt\" AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"sast-scanner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com\" AND protoPayload.request.@type:\"type.googleapis.com/google.cloud.kms.v1.DecryptRequest\"" --limit 20
```
This returns timestamps and request IDs we can cross reference to the PR and whoever changed the IAM binding.

security-oncall: Reminder: when granting perms, use least privilege and an allowlist/denylist boundary. Update the keystore access matrix doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/keystore-access (add the scanner exception flow).

Maria: After Ajay rolled back the RBAC change the premerge SAST ran and PR passed. Confirmed green. I'll capture the timeline.

Lucy: Please create a short blameless postmortem: owner Ajay, timeline, root cause (RBAC role change removed decrypt permission from scanner SA), mitigation (ephemeral grants + CI fallback), next actions.

Ajay: Will file the postmortem under SDLC-345 and schedule a 30-min sync with infra + security tomorrow 10:00. I will also open a PR to add the CI fallback to the canonical actions.

Maria: Thanks all — big help. :rocket:
